author: kwieloch-intel
title: Android CMake configure fails: MODULE_LIBRARY plugins cannot be linked via ov_generate_plugins_hpp
signature: target of type MODULE LIBRARY may not be linked into another target in ov generate plugins hpp|Code Issue
key_errors: CMake Error at cmake/developer_package/plugins/plugins.cmake:275 (target_link_libraries): Target "openvino_auto_plugin" of type MODULE_LIBRARY may not be linked into another target. Call Stack: cmake/extra_modules.cmake:186 (ov_generate_plugins_hpp)
root_cause: The Android CMake configure step fails because ov_generate_plugins_hpp attempts to link MODULE_LIBRARY plugin targets (openvino_auto_plugin, openvino_intel_gpu_plugin, openvino_intel_cpu_plugin, etc.) as dependencies, which CMake prohibits. This is a pre-existing infrastructure issue in cmake/developer_package/plugins/plugins.cmake:275 unrelated to the PR's GPU plugin changes. The same error has been seen 9 prior times since 2026-08-08.
reproduction_steps: Build the Android target with CMake; the configure step will fail with the MODULE_LIBRARY link error.
recommended_actions: This is a pre-existing issue unrelated to PR #37123 (GPU BF16 random_uniform). A fix to cmake/developer_package/plugins/plugins.cmake is needed to avoid linking MODULE_LIBRARY targets.
Track the fix in a dedicated issue; do not block GPU PRs on this.
prevention_strategies: Fix ov_generate_plugins_hpp / ov_target_link_plugins to skip or handle MODULE_LIBRARY targets without issuing a target_link_libraries call.
historical_context: This same CMake error has occurred 9 times previously (first seen 2026-08-08T01:04:42Z) across multiple PRs including #37056, #37064, #37211, #37304.
